# Getting help

GitHub shows this page when you open a new issue. Most questions have a faster answer than waiting for a reply.

## Setting it up

The [README](../README.md#install) covers installing through the Marketplace and the options of the three cards.

## The card stays empty

The cards need a sensor with today's screen time. With Life Dashboard that is `sensor.your_phone_screen_time_today`, from the Android app with the usage access permission. An iPhone has no screen time: iOS has no API for it. The apps per app come from the sensor's attributes or from the app sensors you switched on; the week needs the integration's long-term statistics.

## Still stuck, or want to ask something

[Discussions](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-ha/discussions) of the integration is the place for questions, setup help and ideas. No GitHub account? The [feedback board](https://owen282000.com/life-dashboard/feedback/) needs none. Everything on it is public, so leave out app lists, logs and webhook URLs.

## Reporting a bug

If something is genuinely broken, open an [issue](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-screen-time-card/issues/new/choose).

Security problems go through [private advisories](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-screen-time-card/security/advisories/new), not public issues.
